entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I can't stop thinking about my[n]battle with Takekuma...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I mean, I couldn't do anything to him...[n]There's just no way.
It was pretty weird.[clr 27]
It happens.
He must've rigged it.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Right!? I knew you'd understand!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I've been practicing a lot, after all.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: No, it doesn't!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: This is me we're talking about,[n]remember?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Right!? He must have done[n]something to win...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I've heard rumors about Takekuma![n]People say he uses cheat armor!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You know what that is, right?[n]He totally broke the rules by[n]equipping it...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I bet that's why my usual shots[n]didn't work against him! That[n]has to be the reason!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But the next time we play, I'm definitely...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm definitely gonna demolish him!
You think you have a chance?
I'm sure you can do it.[clr 27]
Don't get so worked up.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Uh...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I mean, even the Phantom Thieves made[n]a comeback victory against Medjed. I'll[n]figure it out!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yep. Even the Phantom Thieves had[n]a comeback victory against Medjed.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm gonna win next time! Just watch!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm NOT!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The thing is...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I told my mom about what happened[n]with Takekuma...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She didn't... really care.[n]All she said was, "Okay."

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's probably because I lost...[n]She doesn't like kids who lose.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: My mom once told me that...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: We need to be strong, because it's[n]just the two of us.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She said no one helps the weak.[n]They just get preyed on...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's why I wanna get stronger.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Strong enough that we won't get[n]preyed on... Strong enough that[n]WE'D be the predators...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's exactly who the Phantom[n]Thieves are... the strongest... who[n]can prey on anyone.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Once I become the strongest, my mom[n]will be able to count on me...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The only way I can win is through games...[n]That's why I can't lose.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: What should I do about Takekuma's[n]armor...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The strategy I used last time didn't work...
Are you going to give up?
You need a new strategy.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Course not, duh. I'm just searching for[n]a solution.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Of course! I'm definitely gonna[n]win next time!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Thanks.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...You're kinda like a big brother to me.[n]I can talk to you about anything...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I heard that that's what it's like to have[n]a sibling...
I feel Shinya's brotherly affection...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Takekuma better watch out...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Crap, look at the time! I gotta go!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: See you later!
